Subject: Invoice XML schema and billing notification routing

Hi Marissa,

We received the initial contract countersign and are ready to onboard Redwood for e-invoicing. Our AP team prefers invoices delivered via our vendor portal (https://portal.scalepartner.com) using a machine-readable XML payload (UBL or Peppol-conformant). A few quick questions to help get the mapping right: 

- Do you support a UBL 2.1 payload today (XML attachment) or do you send an embedded PDF only?
- We need VAT broken out by line item (taxable base / tax amount). Can you provide an example XML that includes tax nodes?
- Our portal also wants a PDF copy in addition to the XML. Is it possible to send both simultaneously?

Attached: portal_onboarding_instructions.pdf (AP portal requirements).

Let me know the point person on your side for the technical onboarding and whether you need our vendor ID/GL mapping upfront.

Thanks,
Tom R.

Tom — thanks for the note and the portal doc. Happy to get this configured. A few answers and next steps from our side: 

- We can produce a UBL-like XML payload and include a PDF copy in the same outgoing envelope (XML + PDF multipart). I'm attaching a sanitized sample XML (redwood_invoice_sample.xml) that includes tax nodes and the PO-matching fields we typically populate.

- We will need the ScalePartner vendor ID you use in the portal, and the preferred AP mailbox to receive copies (if any). Some customers prefer portal-only, others want an email carbon-copy to an AP inbox for archiving.

- Tax/VAT handling: our system will populate VAT per line and a summary block. If you have specific tax codes for items (e.g., reduced rate, zero-rate), please send the mapping so we can ensure correct XML tags.

Next steps: Marcus on my team will coordinate the SFTP/endpoint or API push and Laura will handle the mapping/PO-match configuration. Can you confirm: 1) vendor ID, 2) whether you want copies to accounts.payable@scalepartner.com (or another mailbox), and 3) a sample PO number format so we can add strict matching?

Regards,
